intent: Continue from the current blocked handoff through a candidate-bound P4 release-assurance decision without treating planning as authorization to commit, push, sign, publish, deploy, or release.

steps.action: Reconstruct the P4 execution timeline and determine the safe recovery route from the stale checkpoint to the current revision.
inputs: Current Git revision and worktree evidence
completionCriteria: The last valid checkpoint and all intervening repository changes are identified.
The recovery result selects restart, resume, or replan and states deterministic stop conditions.
No stale checkpoint is represented as directly resumable without compatibility evidence.
steps.rollback: No rollback is required because recovery analysis is read-only.
steps.recovery: If event or checkpoint evidence is inconsistent, keep P4 blocked and repair continuity evidence before proceeding.

steps.action: Review the bounded continuity, clarification, workflow-plan, and validation-generated report changes before defining a candidate revision.
completionCriteria: The exact diff boundary is recorded.
No unresolved high- or critical-severity finding remains in the candidate-preparation boundary.
Validation gaps and generated-report churn are explicit.
steps.rollback: No source rollback is performed by this read-only review.
steps.recovery: Resolve confirmed findings, rerun focused validation, and repeat the same bounded review.

steps.action: Prepare a minimal candidate-freeze boundary and pre-commit checklist without committing or pushing.
completionCriteria: Every proposed path maps to the continuation objective.
The repository gate is current for the proposed boundary.
Commit and push remain unperformed and separately approval-gated.
steps.rollback: Discard only newly generated candidate-preparation artifacts if preparation fails; preserve user-owned changes.
steps.recovery: Return to STEP-002 when the proposed boundary or validation evidence changes.

steps.action: Obtain explicit commit and push approval, then coordinate creation of one clean immutable candidate revision and record its exact commit SHA.
inputs: Explicit user approval for the exact commit and push boundary
completionCriteria: The candidate revision is committed without force or history rewrite.
The approved branch update succeeds and the worktree is clean.
No approval is reused for later commits or pushes.
steps.rollback: Do not rewrite published history; supersede a defective candidate with a separately approved corrective revision.
steps.recovery: On commit or push failure, stop and revalidate the boundary before requesting new approval.

steps.action: Audit the exact frozen candidate and determine whether AUD-0205 or any new blocking finding remains reproducible.
inputs: Current repository instructions and audit schemas
completionCriteria: Audit evidence is bound to the exact candidate revision.
AUD-0205 and any new findings have explicit status and evidence.
The findings report passes deterministic validation.
steps.rollback: No rollback is required for read-only audit outputs.
steps.recovery: If the audit cannot establish current assurance, keep P4 blocked and correct the evidence gap before review.

steps.action: Review current candidate findings without weakening IDs, severity, confidence, evidence, or limitations.
completionCriteria: Every finding remains traceable to candidate-bound evidence.
Confirmed findings and limitations are suitable for remediation planning.
Automated review is not represented as the required distinct qualified human review.
steps.rollback: Preserve the prior review if the new review fails validation.
steps.recovery: Return to STEP-005 if findings lack reproducible evidence.

steps.action: Create a current candidate-bound P4 remediation plan for every confirmed release-assurance gap.
completionCriteria: The plan includes signing, independent review, artifact health, revocation, and production verification when still unresolved.
Dependencies are acyclic and ownership is explicit.
The plan passes schema and deterministic validation.
steps.rollback: Do not alter immutable prior snapshots; reject and replace only the mutable current-plan view.
steps.recovery: Return to STEP-006 when the review cannot support an executable remediation plan.

steps.action: Refresh architecture assurance for the exact candidate, including operational ownership, artifact distribution, health, and revocation design.
inputs: Current release architecture and operational evidence
completionCriteria: Architecture evidence is current and candidate-bound.
Operational ownership, health signals, and revocation routes are passed or explicitly blocked.
Unknown external controls fail closed.
steps.rollback: Preserve the last valid review if refresh fails.
steps.recovery: Keep P4 blocked and assign missing operational controls before repeating the review.

steps.action: Refresh security assurance for the exact candidate and signing, artifact, identity, and revocation trust boundaries.
inputs: Current signing, provenance, artifact, and access-control evidence
completionCriteria: Security evidence is current and candidate-bound.
Signer separation, reviewer independence, artifact access, and revocation controls are passed or blocked.
No secret values are recorded in reports.
steps.rollback: Preserve the last valid review if refresh fails.
steps.recovery: Keep P4 blocked until missing identity or trust evidence is supplied and independently reviewable.

steps.action: Evaluate candidate readiness for the named restricted internal environment without deploying or promoting it.
completionCriteria: Every readiness gate is passed, failed, or not applicable with evidence.
Installation verification and rollback triggers are observable and time-bounded.
The review remains blocked when the target environment or rollback route is unknown.
steps.rollback: No deployment occurs in this step.
steps.recovery: Supply missing target, health, or rollback evidence and rerun the read-only review.

steps.action: Assign a distinct qualified reviewer who did not author or sign the candidate and record the review scope.
completionCriteria: The reviewer is distinct from the candidate author and signer.
Qualifications and exact candidate review scope are recorded without sensitive data.
Assignment approval is current and scoped to this candidate.
steps.rollback: Withdraw the assignment without altering prior review evidence.
steps.recovery: Keep P4 blocked and nominate a different qualified reviewer.

steps.action: Assign a controlled signing identity and independently pinned trust anchor for the exact candidate.
completionCriteria: Signer custody is separate from independent review.
The trust anchor can be independently pinned and verified.
No private key or credential value is recorded in project evidence.
steps.rollback: Remove the candidate assignment without deleting historical identity evidence.
steps.recovery: Keep P4 blocked and assign a compliant controlled signer and trust anchor.

steps.action: Assign a restricted internal artifact destination and define installation-health and revocation acceptance criteria.
outputs: Named restricted artifact destination and owner
Revocation test procedure and verification criteria
completionCriteria: The destination is restricted to authorized internal use and has a named owner.
Health signals and stop thresholds are observable.
Revocation initiation, propagation, and verification steps are testable.
steps.rollback: Withdraw the destination from candidate use and preserve prior evidence.
steps.recovery: Keep P4 blocked until a restricted destination and testable controls are approved.

steps.action: Evaluate the exact P4 execution request and enumerate phase, external, privileged, signing, publication, revocation, commit, push, and release approvals.
inputs: Current architecture, security, and deployment reviews
Named reviewer, signer, artifact owner, and release owner
Proposed action scopes and mutation levels
completionCriteria: Every proposed action has an allow, deny, or require-approval decision with rule trace.
Missing context produces a blocked or denied decision.
Policy output is not treated as user approval.
steps.rollback: Policy evaluation is read-only; append-only decision records are never rewritten.
steps.recovery: Correct incomplete action attributes or controls and issue a new policy evaluation.

steps.action: Snapshot the validated plan, then execute the separately approved P4 phase against the exact candidate and record terminal evidence.
inputs: Separate point-of-action approvals for external, privileged, signing, publication, revocation, commit, push, or release actions
outputs: Candidate-bound checksums, SBOM, provenance, signature, review, CI, health, revocation, and production-verification evidence
completionCriteria: The execution binds its immutable plan snapshot before mutation.
All P4 acceptance criteria pass for the same commit and candidate digest.
Any denied, failed, stale, or missing control leaves P4 blocked.
steps.rollback: Reinstate blockers, stop distribution, and invoke the tested revocation route when candidate or trust evidence becomes invalid.
steps.recovery: Checkpoint partial outcomes, publish terminal handoff, and resume only after workflow-recovery verifies side effects and approvals.

steps.action: Re-audit the exact candidate and verify whether AUD-0205 can be closed from current evidence.
inputs: Exact candidate commit SHA and digest
completionCriteria: AUD-0205 closes only if it is no longer reproducible and every acceptance criterion passes.
Stale, missing, or mismatched evidence preserves the finding and blocked status.
The final audit report passes deterministic validation.
steps.rollback: Reopen AUD-0205 if later evidence invalidates closure.
steps.recovery: Return to the failed P4 control through a new reviewed remediation plan rather than editing historical evidence.

steps.action: Publish synchronized terminal continuity for completed, blocked, failed, deferred, and pending work with one next action.
inputs: Latest completed, blocked, or failed workflow outcome
completionCriteria: Completed actions are removed from the active resume path.
Blocked, failed, deferred, and pending work remains explicit.
The handoff identifies exactly one next eligible action and does not reuse consumed approvals.
steps.rollback: Preserve the previous valid handoff if synchronized publication fails.
steps.recovery: Regenerate all three continuity artifacts from the same latest valid checkpoint.
